label: caiso r1 baseline limb
definition: (PROBE) B-LIMB-1 same-env baseline: caiso-51-firm-base on current main with the SP15/CC_REGULAR tmax reliability-floor limb ON (original CSV). Limb-ON reference for the caiso-r1-signflip-off probe; the two isolate the R1 disablement (Δ≈0, floor non-binding). Also documents caiso-51 keeper drift on current main: CT_PEAKER total ~1.7 TWh / C8 forced-share 60-71% vs the committed bundle's ~3.4 TWh / 27-33% (separate root-cause item).
market_story: Re-solving the caiso-51 keeper config on current main (limb ON) reproduces CC_REGULAR, price and CO2 within ~1% of the committed bundle but shows CT_PEAKER energy roughly halved and its C8 forced-share doubled — a keeper-reproducibility drift independent of B-LIMB-1, flagged for the CAISO owner.
ablation_twin: Reference (limb-ON) half of the B-LIMB-1 A/B; not itself a probe subject.
